name: Madurai

queries.query: மதுரை பட்டா சிட்டா FMB நில வரைபடம் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ கணக்கெடுப்பு
queries.scope: Locate official Madurai urban parcel and survey-map access.
queries.result: The official Madurai district page links the Tamil Nadu e-Services land portal and explicitly lists Patta/FMB, Chitta and TSLR extracts. The district Survey page identifies original town-survey records at the Central Survey Office, Chennai, and TSLR/block maps at the concerned Taluk Office. Following the official link to the TSLR-capable extract page (`https://eservices.tn.gov.in/eservicesnew/land/chittaExtract_en.html?lan=en`) and to the linked e-Services home, read-only GETs timed out from this network path. No full-polygon response was retrieved; the service is an extract/sketch route rather than a verified GeoJSON feature API.
queries.executionMethod: Native-language search, official district page inspection, then read-only follow-through to the linked state land-record home and TSLR-capable extract route; those portal GETs timed out.

queries.query: Madurai official land records TSLR FMB cadastral map parcel GIS public map
queries.scope: Cross-check English official services and determine whether town survey maps expose vector geometry.
queries.result: The official district e-services page directs residents to the state service for Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR. The Government of India service description gives the urban lookup hierarchy (district, urban/rural selection, town, ward, block, survey number and subdivision). Direct tests of the state service home and TSLR-capable chittaExtract page timed out, so no map, extract, parcel identifier or full geometry response was inspected. The city Survey page documents who holds TSLR/block-map records but is not an online vector route.
queries.executionMethod: English search plus official Madurai e-services link follow-through; state portal GETs timed out; government-service directory reviewed for urban selector fields.

portals.name: Madurai district land services and survey records
portals.operator: District Administration Madurai, Government of Tamil Nadu
portals.observation: Official service information links to an extract system that covers urban TSLR and rural FMB. The linked state home and TSLR-capable extract route timed out on direct read; the outputs are document/extract/sketch services, and no full-geometry feature API was verified.

requests.observation: Official city-district page identifies Original Town Survey records at Central Survey Office, Chennai and TSLR/block maps at the concerned Taluk Office.
Official district land-services page links public Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR services; page does not expose full parcel geometry.
Read-only request to the exact state portal home linked by Madurai District timed out before an HTTP response; this is recorded as a local reachability limitation, not a provider outage.
Read-only follow-through to the TSLR-capable extract route referenced by the official e-Services service and published records also timed out before an HTTP response. No parcel values were submitted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Madurai city land records include urban Town Survey Land Register (TSLR) extracts and town-survey block maps; state e-Services also provides FMB records.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official Madurai pages and linked service describe TSLR/FMB document routes. The linked state portal home and extract endpoint timed out; no actual TSLR record or full parcel geometry was observed, and coverage at the WUP point remains unknown.

technicalBlocker: The available official interface is an extract/sketch workflow requiring administrative and survey identifiers; its linked home and TSLR-capable extract endpoint timed out on direct access, and no feature geometry endpoint was identified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the TSLR sketch route returns a full vector geometry or a rendered document; exact Madurai town/ward/block/survey identifiers at the WUP point; portal access from a browser path.
nextStep: From the live state e-Services UI, select the Madurai urban district and resolve town/ward/block/survey number at the WUP point; inspect whether TSLR sketch is only a document or exposes full geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Madurai city district pages explicitly identify TSLR/Original Town Survey records, their custodians, and the state extract service serving the city. The record system is confirmed; anonymous feature geometry is not.
